source_title: ISE top 10 stats of 2025 you need to know (8 Dec 2025)
headline: Graduate hiring fell, apprentice hiring rose
detail: School and college leaver hiring rose 8%; the entry-level market overall fell 5%.
update_2026: 2025/26: graduate hiring recovered 4%, but 0.8% excluding a few large employers.

headline: Median graduate starting salary
